name: OpenVibe.Blog

site.name: Blog
site.what: The official OpenVibe blog and a blog for every member: drafts, scheduling, media, comments and feeds.

liveness.means: the process is up and answers HTTP; it checks nothing else (the database and dependencies are what ready checks)

resumes.what: scheduled publish/unpublish jobs that fell due, and running jobs whose lease expired, are claimed again (openvibe-publishing/schedule, at least once, re-run safe)
unsent events in the outbox table go to OpenVibe.Events once the relay starts (at least once; Events dedupes by event_id)

conditions: automatic: ovhost deploy puts the previous sha back and restarts again when the ready URL does not answer 2xx within ready.timeoutSeconds after the restart (exit 3)
rollback.window: automatic only while ovhost waits for readiness after the restart (30 s in host.example.json); manual afterwards, as long as no blocker applies

blockers.none: the schema code only adds (CREATE … IF NOT EXISTS, ADD COLUMN; no DROP, RENAME or table rebuild), which an older release ignores

claims.expires: lease_until = claim time + 60 s (leaseMs); taken again only after it passed
claims.fencing: complete, retry and fail only count WHERE lease_owner is the caller, so a worker whose lease was taken over cannot overwrite the new owner's result

notes: Port 4810. Owns blogs, blog_memberships, blog_posts, blog_post_revisions, blog_series, blog_taxonomy, blog_post_terms, blog_schedules, blog_redirects, blog_feed_settings in its own SQLite (openvibe-publishing packages, prefix blog). Consumes OpenVibe.Network (SSO, identity.subject.resolve), OpenVibe.Community (community.comment.write, community.comment.moderate), OpenVibe.Media (media.object.read, namespace blog) and publishes through OpenVibe.Events (events.event.publish); OpenVibe.Search reads blog.index_document.* from Events.
